after_snippet:
import redis

# In 8.0.0, Lock.extend() and Lock.reacquire() are typed as returning Literal[True]
# These methods only succeed or raise, so Literal[True] is more precise
client = redis.Redis(host='localhost', port=6379)
lock = client.lock('mykey')
assert True
before_snippet:
import redis

# In 7.4.1, Lock.extend() and Lock.reacquire() returned generic bool
client = redis.Redis(host='localhost', port=6379)
lock = client.lock('mykey')
# The return type annotation was bool, not Literal[True]
assert True
title: Lock.extend() and Lock.reacquire() now return Literal[True] instead of bool
